name: Cognitive Science Building
provenance: Nine classroom outlines traced from UC San Diego's 2018 Cognitive Science Building emergency plans. Door details and floor boundaries are simplified; relative floor alignment and heights are illustrative. This historical plan may predate alterations.

coordinateSystem.description: 1 unit = 10 PDF points on the first-floor drawing. Other floors are aligned to three common building/core corners. No measured scale or campus georeference is claimed.
coordinateSystem.northNote: The north arrow printed on every source page points toward page-up; floor registration uses scale and translation only.

sources.revision: 04/11/18 printed on plans; PDF metadata creation 2018-11-07
notes: Manually reviewed room identities and long wall segments in the original vector PDF and rendered page crops. Room polygons follow the principal interior wall lines; door swings, door recesses, thin walls and small columns are simplified. Exterior outlines are simplified traces, not surveyed boundaries. Other room interiors are not traced.
Physical PDF pages 2, 3 and 4 were rendered and visually reviewed; classroom room numbers were cross-checked against PDF text.

notes: Historical emergency diagrams may predate room alterations. The PDF has no scale bar or measured wall dimensions.
Room shapes simplify small door recesses and wall thickness. Their principal boundaries are supported by the source drawing; shape confidence is approximate.
The basement has a different footprint from the upper floors and a separately shown northwest stair core. Its main floor outline is retained separately.
Three common exterior/core anchors support approximate floor alignment. Vertical spacing is illustrative. The supplement intentionally omits campus georeferencing and uses relative units.
Only the nine scheduled classrooms are traced; offices and other interior spaces remain unmodeled. Courtyard voids are retained on the upper floors.
